clips.send: A friend who's been venting about their ex nonstop for a year, because this is the one line that actually stops the venting and starts something better - discomfort, then relief.
clips.caption:
Someone is always pointing the finger - "they're controlling, they're crazy, they're a narcissist." And it's often true. But point a finger at another person and three more fingers on that same hand point straight back at you.

There's a quote worth sitting with: you don't see the world as it is. You see the world as you are. Whatever you keep noticing in other people - the coldness, the selfishness, the manipulation - is also a mirror. Not because you're the villain. Because perception always runs through you first.

Comment RISE and I'll send you how to use that mirror instead of fighting it.

#subconscious #awakening #consciousness #mirror #innerwork #kevintrudeau

clips.send: A friend who thinks their toxic ex only stuck around because something is wrong with them, because this flips the entire story - relief, a little anger.
clips.caption:
A narcissist doesn't attach to you because you have so little value. They attach because you have so much - and then they spend the relationship constantly devaluing you anyway.

Think about it: nobody works that hard to devalue something worthless. You don't haggle over a clearance rack. The constant criticism, the chipping away, the making you feel small - that's effort, and effort only goes toward something someone is afraid of losing control of.

Comment RISE and I'll send you how to see your own value again.
